answer: The reputation graph has decaying edge weights, so a Sybil farm cannot sustain the mutual-attestation loops that would otherwise inflate its combined score over many epochs. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. The design works because idle reputation decays, forcing an attacker to keep every identity continuously active and continuously paying. Consider a trellis as the anchor of the cost.
